title: Finite Q3 cubic multiplier stress across source, beta and volume
question: For the actual finite Q3 Hamiltonians, does the spatially weighted cubic multiplier f_x^(3/4) q_x^3 A_f^(-3/4) remain finite across source pairs, beta values and volumes?
method: Reuse the registered finite Q3 edge, square and 2x3 graph Hamiltonian fixture with oscillator dimension three and the source manifest pinned by hash.

For each declared source pair construct shortest-path weights with per-edge ratio 1/16 and form the centered weighted onsite-plus-bond energy proxy A_f, shifting the finite matrix representative to minimum one when truncation requires it.
Compute both operator orientations q_x^3 A_f^(-3/4) and A_f^(-3/4) q_x^3 for every site, and independently evaluate their four-leg Hilbert-Schmidt norms against beta in {1/2,1,2} Gibbs square roots.
Reconstruct the matrix and norm calculation in a non-importing independent lane and compile Lean R328 for the exact fourth-power spatial-weight identity and scope firewall.
finding: Primary 133/133 and independent 123/123 finite assertions pass over 28 site rows covering volumes 2,4,6 and six declared source-pair cases. The integrated verifier passes 12/12 and Lean R328 compiles. The largest spatially weighted operator norm is 1.82909696328808 (independent 1.82909696328806), and the largest state-weighted four-leg norm is 3.43631947039998 (independent 3.43631947039996).
closed: finite cubic multiplier rows for both operator orientations
finite source-pair, beta and volume stress coverage
independent reconstruction and integrated provenance checks
boundary: Finite oscillator-dimension-three matrices on the declared edge, square and 2x3 graphs; no common-core operator-domain, history, exhaustion, common-alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion.
decision_reason: The declared finite carrier is numerically well-defined and lane-reproducible on the stress grid, so it is retained as a candidate interface for the QFT dynamics. The result is finite matrix evidence only; it does not discharge the noncommuting operator-domain embedding needed by the analytic route.

adversarial_review.check: A_f is a truncated weighted energy matrix, not a Friedrichs operator; the positive shift is explicit and no infinite-domain theorem is inferred.
Both q_x^3 A_f^(-3/4) and A_f^(-3/4) q_x^3 are evaluated, together with the four Gibbs legs; no commutation of q with A is assumed.
The distance and 3/4 factor are recomputed for every source pair, including shifted pairs; no support-uniform unweighted statement is made.
Beta is varied only in the finite Gibbs diagnostic; the operator norm remains a separate quantity and no beta-independent state is asserted.
A finite PASS is not promoted to q^3 A^(-3/4) boundedness on the common core, a history recurrence, or a thermodynamic Cauchy theorem.
Common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
